capabilities: Generate timeline views from folders, tags, metadata, or file links
Mark milestones via a custom frontmatter property
Choose which date property sorts the timeline
Customize timeline appearance, card colors, and sidebar position
extras: README links to a separate Chinese documentation page; documentation is available in Chinese and English.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view collections of notes ordered by their date properties in a timeline.
summary: Timeline generator that builds chronological views or Markdown files from folders, tags, metadata filters, or a file's internal links.
